requirements.text: Allow students to customize their timetables with color-coding, hide cancelled classes, and add study blocks
Ensure seamless integration of new features with the existing system without requiring changes to the login process or database structure
Maintain current performance levels when implementing new features
Implement reliable notifications for grade postings, assignment deadlines, and exam dates
Ensure the system can handle additional demands from notifications without performance issues
Enable students to submit anonymous feedback on module content and delivery after the modules end
Restrict access to feedback for module coordinators until grades are finalized
